checks.subject: tvapi_plus status refresh
checks.method: Temporary local HTTP server: primary endpoint returned 503; configured fallback returned a valid TVBox configuration. Refresher parsed it and recorded used_fallback=true.
checks.method_zh: 临时本机 HTTP 服务：主地址返回 503，配置的备用地址返回合法 TVBox 配置；刷新器成功解析并记录 used_fallback=true。
checks.limitations: Validates fetch/fallback/parse/report behavior only; no third-party Spider execution or client import/playback.

checks.subject: Lightconer/tvbox-ysc-config updater
checks.method: Called the repository's fetch_config on Xiaoma: parsed 62 sites and 10 live entries. In an isolated temporary output directory, a local primary returned 503 then a local fallback returned a valid config; a subsequent all-failure run reused the cached payload and generated single/multi outputs.
checks.method_zh: 调用仓库 fetch_config 抓取小马配置，解析出 62 个站点、10 个直播项。随后在隔离临时输出目录中用本机服务模拟主地址 503、备用地址成功；再次让地址全部失败时成功复用缓存并生成单仓/多仓产物。
checks.limitations: Temporary fixtures validate updater behavior; not a TVBox client playback test.

checks.subject: lubin776/tvbox-api-backup downloader
checks.method: Repository check-config reported 71 interface groups. With the repository's loopback-only CI guard bypassed in memory for the isolated fixture, process() used a local primary returning 503 then a local fallback returning a valid TVBox config and emitted one site. Separately, try_fetch_all fetched a public fallback after a deliberately failing GitHub URL and parsed 27 sites and 12 live entries.
checks.method_zh: 仓库 check-config 列出 71 个接口分组。在隔离夹具中仅以内存方式绕过仓库对 loopback 的 CI 保护，process() 经历本机主地址 503、备用地址成功并输出 1 个站点。另一次 try_fetch_all 在 GitHub 地址故意失败后获取公开备用配置，解析出 27 个站点、12 个直播项。
checks.limitations: Loopback guard was not changed on disk. Upstream downloader configures TLS verification off; this is a security concern, not an endorsement. No client playback test.
